name: rea-static
description: Evidence-based static reverse engineering through a pinned, root-scoped REA wrapper.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect artifacts within an explicit analysis root
interface.longDescription: Discover a small set of static REA tools and trace artifact evidence. Runtime debugging, target execution, device access, and network tools are disabled.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $rea-static-analysis to analyze the selected owned artifact with evidence.
